title.narrative: Integrated Health Program (IHP) Task Order Seven (TO7)

description.narrative: (Nigeria): With FY 2022 funds this activity will:.Advance the goals of a bilateral Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) held by USAID and the FCT, outlining both parties' roles in contributing to the reduction of maternal and child mortality and increasing the health system capacity to sustainably support quality PHC services;.Utilize low-dose, high-frequency training, delivered through grants under contracts, and supportive supervision to strengthen clinical competencies for health workers and improve service quality for reproductive; maternal; newborn; child and adolescent health; and nutrition at primary and secondary levels. Support will extend to one PHC in each of the 62 wards, 14 general hospitals, and 62 private clinics across all six area councils;.Strengthen FCT health systems such as the development and tracking of the 2023 harmonized health operational plan; continued roll out of the FCT Basic Health Care Provision Fund and Health Management Information Systems to ensure government partners have critical information for results-oriented, data-driven decisions; and incorporation of gender transformative approaches and the promotion of essential WASH actions such as environmental hygiene, handwashing and safe waste disposal at the facility level..This activity focuses on evidence-based reproductive, maternal, newborn, and child health interventions, sustainability, and capacity building, thus contributing to USAID/Nigeria's health and development objective of a healthier, more educated population in targeted states. It will strengthen health systems, increase access to and improve the quality of primary health care (PHC) in the Federal Capital Territory (FCT). It also contributes to USAID priorities by focusing on evidence-based interventions, sustainability, localization and capacity building. This activity contributes directly to USAID Nigeria CDCS Development Objective 2, the ICS, and Goal 3 of the 2022-2026 Joint Strategic Plan..
